edit.hint: Edit layout - drag the top strip to move, the bottom-right corner to resize
toast.empty: Right-click the tray icon → Add widget
toast.no_space: No free space - close or shrink a widget
toast.overlap: No free space, so it was placed overlapping
toast.save_failed: Couldn't save - check disk space or folder permissions
toast.reflowed: The screen size changed, so some widgets were moved
toast.error: Something went wrong, but the app is still running
toast.widget_error: This widget failed to load. Right-click → Close
toast.unknown_widget: Unknown widget (maybe made by a newer version). Right-click → Close
toast.migrate_failed: Converting your data to the new version failed. Your data from before is in the backups folder.
a11y.grip: {name} - arrows: move · Shift+arrows: resize · Delete: close · Menu key: menu
focus.on: Focus mode - only this widget is shown
kbd.on: Keyboard mode - Tab: next widget · S: summary · L: list all · Esc: leave
ov.title: Widgets as text
a11y.carrying: Widget picked up. Click again where you want to drop it (Esc cancels)
a11y.hotkey_taken: {key} is used by another program. Please pick another shortcut
look.title: Widget appearance
look.colors: Colours for this widget (unset = follow the theme)
look.svg_big: That SVG is too large (max 100 KB)
look.svg_bad: That is not an SVG file
wc.title: Welcome to WidgetBoard
wc.body: Pick a layout to start with. You can add widgets later from the tray menu.
lay.partial: The screen is too small for some widgets; they were left out
toast.hidden: Hid {name}. Show it again from Settings → Widgets
layers.title: Layers
layers.hint: Top is front. Drag a row to change the order. Ctrl+] / Ctrl+[ moves the selected widget one layer, with Shift to the front or back.
layers.locked: This widget's position is locked. Unlock it in Layers.
